verdict.rationale: Docs confirm reviewing payroll accuracy before running payroll (via Analytics > Custom Payroll Report) and recommend monthly reviews, implying a review-then-run flow, but no evidence describes a 'preview totals' step or an explicit one-click submit action. missing for 10: documentation of a preview-totals screen, an explicit submit/run-payroll confirmation step, and any hands-on/independent account of the full end-to-end flow.
